instruction: Play any song released in 2020 from my Spotify playlists.
notes: Single-app task. Knowledge flow: passwords -> spotify login -> show_playlist_library lists the supervisor's playlists -> show_playlist lists a playlist's songs -> show_song reveals the release year -> play_music with song_id. Release years and playlist membership are encoded as static world facts in :init (released-in / in-playlist); the agent's knowledge of them is tracked separately via playlist-library-listed, playlist-songs-listed and found-release-year, so the planner must perform the lookups before playing. The target year 2020 is a domain constant so supervisor-complete-task can require (playing-song-of-year year-2020) without quantification. play-music is restricted to one invocation (music-started) so exactly one MusicPlayer update occurs and the current song is the 2020 one. Placeholder playlists/songs stand in for the unknown library contents; at runtime the agent picks any library song whose show_song release_date starts with 2020. complete_task is called with no answer.
